NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author pushed once, dropping the six per-severity fixture files, so the PR is now only `view.py` and `tests.py`. The new comment just tags the reviewer and doesn't answer his questions or explain what changed.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | Separate per-severity fixtures are gone, which matches the ask to avoid one fixture per status. |
| ❌  | The description still says the feature depends on the `include_emoji_indicators` parameter, but the author said on CZO that he removed it. |
| ❌  | His questions about what the model PRs did for `doc.md` and the fixtures are unanswered, and no `doc.md` change is in the PR. |
| ⚠️  | The "Explains differences from previous plans" checklist item is still unchecked, and the description doesn't mention the emoji mapping changes. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to bring the description in line with the code and to address the `doc.md` question before Niloth-p reviews again.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! Before @Niloth-p takes another look, please update the PR description so it matches the code (it still mentions `include_emoji_indicators`). Also reply to the questions in the earlier review about what the model emoji integration PRs did for `doc.md`, and make that change if it applies here. The [incoming webhooks guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/index.html) covers this.
```
